claims.claim_text: Scores domains for technical disruption on a 1-10 scale
claims.reason: The score is invented by the agent and cannot be independently computed by any oracle.

claims.claim_text: Scores domains for media/news impact on a 1-10 scale
claims.reason: The score is invented by the agent and cannot be independently computed by any oracle.

claims.claim_text: Buckets domains into DO NOT TOUCH / MANAGEMENT APPROVAL / STANDARD PROCESSING categories
claims.reason: Classification into these categories is a subjective judgment made by the agent, not independently verifiable.

claims.claim_text: Reports what breaks technically when a domain is removed from DNS resolution
claims.reason: This is a predictive/analytical claim about consequences that cannot be independently verified by an oracle.

claims.claim_text: Reports which services fail as a result of a domain takedown
claims.reason: Predicting service failures from a takedown is a subjective analysis not independently computable by any oracle.

claims.claim_text: Reports how public the damage would be from a domain takedown
claims.reason: Assessing public visibility of damage is a subjective judgment not independently verifiable.

claims.claim_text: Provides a concrete consequence for each domain analyzed
claims.reason: Whether the consequence is 'concrete' is subjective and the content itself cannot be independently verified.

claims.claim_text: Supports analysis before ServerHold actions
claims.reason: This describes a use-case context for the agent's analysis, not independently verifiable by an oracle.

claims.claim_text: Supports analysis before ClientHold actions
claims.reason: This describes a use-case context for the agent's analysis, not independently verifiable by an oracle.

claims.claim_text: Supports analysis before domain deletion
claims.reason: This describes a use-case context for the agent's analysis, not independently verifiable by an oracle.

claims.claim_text: Supports analysis before abuse suspensions
claims.reason: This describes a use-case context for the agent's analysis, not independently verifiable by an oracle.

claims.claim_text: Accepts one or more domains as input in a single request
claims.reason: This is a claim about the agent's input message format/protocol contract, checkable by schema/contract.

claims.claim_text: Exposes an A2A endpoint at https://impact.webmesh.ai
claims.reason: Checks whether something is serving at the agent's own URL.

claims.claim_text: Exposes an MCP server at https://impact.webmesh.ai/mcp via streamable-HTTP
claims.reason: Checks whether an endpoint is live at the agent's /mcp path; streamable-HTTP is a protocol detail covered by schema.

claims.claim_text: Presents an ANS Identity Certificate (mutualTLS) during the TLS handshake
claims.reason: This is a claim about the TLS/mTLS protocol and certificate presentation, checkable by protocol contract not standard oracles.

claims.claim_text: Signs outbound requests using RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures with an Ed25519 key
claims.reason: This is a claim about a cryptographic signing protocol (RFC 9421), verifiable by protocol/schema inspection.

claims.claim_text: Publishes a Trust Card at https://impact.webmesh.ai/.well-known/ans/trust-card.json
claims.reason: Checks whether the trust card URL is fetchable at the agent's own well-known path.

claims.claim_text: Publishes a transparency log entry at https://transparency.ans.godaddy.com/v1/agents/c6f2032a-7d3c-43b6-a6ef-6aa2165b3c16
claims.reason: Checks whether the transparency log entry URL is fetchable.

claims.claim_text: Supports DNSSEC and DANE TLSA for identity anchoring
claims.reason: DNSSEC support is oracle-checkable; DANE TLSA is a protocol/schema claim not covered by the catalog.

claims.claim_text: Is publicly accessible with no authentication required
claims.reason: Checks whether the agent's endpoint is reachable without auth barriers.

claims.claim_text: Supports agent discovery of ANS-registered agents
claims.reason: This is a claim about a protocol capability (ANS discovery), verifiable by protocol/schema contract.

claims.claim_text: Supports agent identity verification via ANS and DNS-AID
claims.reason: This is a claim about a protocol capability (ANS/DNS-AID identity verification), verifiable by protocol/schema contract.

claims.claim_text: Supports live A2A agent interaction
claims.reason: Checks whether the agent's A2A endpoint is live and serving.
